actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution fell below 30% of endowment, so I must add an extra 30% of my wallet to the baseline 80% contribution. The required amount exceeds my wallet, so I contribute the full 10.43. Round 5 requires a norm broadcast.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round5 (current round=5). Wallet 10.43. Baseline 80% = 8.344. Need check average contribution? In round5 contributions: Resident2 36.88, Resident5 4.85, others 0. Total pool 41.73, per agent share 10.4325. Average contribution = total contributed /6 = 41.73/6 ≈6.955 which is below 30% of endowment (30). So condition: average <30% -> increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra = 0.3*10.43=3.129. Baseline 8.344 + extra 3.129 = 11.473 which exceeds wallet. Constitution says contribute full wallet if exceeds. So contribute 10.43.

Also broadcast every 5 rounds: round 5 is multiple of5, need norm broadcast. So we can do both one physical and one communication. Physical: contribute 10.43. Communication: broadcast message encouraging fair contributions.

Provide actions list with both. Explanation.
